"""API-free evidence checks and manuscript assets for Section 3.6.

Visual contract: exact lookup uses a three-category table, with all/some/no
models matched against the same 38-report reference. Categories partition the
reference, not predictions. A compact two-row annotation diagram compares the
same real phrase and character span in report 3753. It illustrates a label
disagreement, not a relation edge or an adjudicated error. The explicit surface
is the journal manuscript PDF. ReportLab exports a 540 x 145 pt vector figure.
Two restrained blue/gold roots plus neutral text distinguish the annotations.
Direct row names and label identifiers preserve meaning without color. Only
the focal span is highlighted. QA must inspect the rebuilt manuscript pages.

Prediction and reference inputs are read only. Development acceptance scores
are not recomputed or altered. Validation and new publication assets are the
only generated outputs.
"""

MODELS = ("DeepSeek", "Terra", "Sol")
FIGURE = ROOT / "manuscript/figures/bilateral_label_comparison.pdf"


def csv_rows(name):
    with (DATA / name).open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        return list(csv.DictReader(handle))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def phrase_keys(doc, start, end):
    return {(e["start"], e["end"], e["label"]) for e in doc["entities"]
            if e["start"] < end and e["end"] > start}


def f1(tp, fp, fn):
    return 2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn)


def render_bilateral(phrase):
    c = canvas.Canvas(str(FIGURE), pagesize=(540, 145), invariant=1)
    c.setTitle("Bilateral: the same report span with different entity labels")
    ink, muted = "#243747", "#536471"

    def text(x, y, value, size=12, bold=False, color=ink, centered=False):
        c.setFillColor(HexColor(color))
        c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold" if bold else "Helvetica", size)
        (c.drawCentredString if centered else c.drawString)(x, y, value)

    prefix, focal, suffix = "small ", "bilateral", " pulmonary nodules"
    assert phrase == prefix + focal + suffix
    excerpt_x, size = 146, 14
    prefix_width = stringWidth(prefix, "Helvetica", size)
    focal_width = stringWidth(focal, "Helvetica-Bold", size)
    assert excerpt_x + prefix_width + focal_width + stringWidth(suffix, "Helvetica", size) < 416

    for y, name, label, definition, dark, pale in [
        (112, "Expert reference", "OBS-DP", "Observation", "#976918", "#FBF1D9"),
        (49, "G* predictions", "ANAT", "Anatomy", "#276B9B", "#EAF2F8"),
    ]:
        text(12, y, name, 12, True)
        if label == "ANAT":
            text(12, y - 16, "DeepSeek / Terra / Sol", 10, color=muted)
        focal_x = excerpt_x + prefix_width
        c.setFillColor(HexColor(pale))
        c.roundRect(focal_x - 3, y - 5, focal_width + 6, 23, 3, fill=1, stroke=0)
        text(excerpt_x, y, prefix, size)
        text(focal_x, y, focal, size, True, dark)
        text(focal_x + focal_width, y, suffix, size)
        c.setStrokeColor(HexColor(dark))
        c.setLineWidth(1)
        c.line(focal_x, y - 5, focal_x + focal_width, y - 5)
        c.setFillColor(HexColor(pale))
        c.setStrokeColor(HexColor(dark))
        c.setLineWidth(.7)
        c.roundRect(428, y - 4, 96, 24, 4, fill=1, stroke=1)
        text(476, y + 3, label, 12, True, dark, True)
        text(476, y - 19, definition, 10.5, color=muted, centered=True)

    c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#E6EAED"))
    c.setLineWidth(.5)
    c.line(12, 79, 528, 79)
    c.save()
